sentences.en: The first emperor of China was used to getting his way.
sentences.zh: 中国的第一位皇帝习惯了随心所欲。

sentences.en: By the time he was 40, Qin Shua Huangdi was the most powerful man in the world.
sentences.zh: 到40岁时，秦始皇已是世界上最有权势的人。

sentences.en: During his reign some 2,000 years ago, he united the warring nations of his kingdom.
sentences.zh: 在大约2000年前的统治期间，他统一了国内交战的各国。

sentences.en: He standardized currency and weights and measures.
He unified border walls into a single block that would eventually become the Great Wall of China.
sentences.zh: 他将边境的城墙连接成一个整体，这最终成为了中国的长城。

sentences.en: And so it seemed to this man, who was larger than life, who had achieved so many things,
sentences.zh: 因此，对于这位成就非凡、功绩卓著的人来说，他似乎觉得，

sentences.en: that he could also conquer something no one had conquered before.
sentences.zh: 他也可以征服前人从未征服过的东西。

sentences.en: He went searching for an elixir that would give him eternal life.
sentences.zh: 他开始寻找能让他长生不老的灵丹妙药。

sentences.en: He traveled his kingdom, talking to wizards and alchemists and wise people and priests.
sentences.zh: 他走遍全国，与巫师、炼金术士、智者和祭司交谈。

sentences.en: And one day, in some distant part of his kingdom, he found a wise man who said,
sentences.zh: 有一天，在他王国的某个遥远角落，他遇到了一位智者，对方说：

sentences.en: I know the recipe for an elixir.
sentences.zh: 我知道长生不老药的配方。
这位是哲学家斯蒂芬·凯夫。

sentences.en: He says the wise man was a wizard named Shui Fu.
sentences.zh: 他说那位智者是一位名叫徐福的方士。

sentences.en: And Shui Fu's offer to get the elixir came with a few conditions.
sentences.zh: 而徐福提出获取灵药的条件有几个。

sentences.en: You just have to get it from this distant island.
sentences.zh: 你只需要从那个遥远的岛屿上取来即可。

sentences.en: And if you give me a ship fully equipped and loaded with virgins,
sentences.zh: 如果你给我一艘装备齐全、载满童男童女的船，

sentences.en: I will be able to go to this island and get the elixir of life for you.
sentences.zh: 我就能去那个岛上为你取回长生不老药。

sentences.en: He gave Shui Fu the ship, the provisions and the virgins.
sentences.zh: 他给了徐福船只、补给和童男童女。

sentences.en: And then he carried on ruling over his great empire.
sentences.zh: 然后他继续统治着他伟大的帝国。

sentences.en: And when he came back to the wizard, a few years later,
sentences.zh: 几年后，当他再次找到那位方士时，

sentences.en: he found out that the virgins were no longer virginal,
sentences.zh: 他发现那些童女已不再是处子之身，

sentences.en: that the provisions had all gone.
And he wondered where this elixir was.
sentences.zh: 他不禁纳闷灵药在哪里。

sentences.en: And the wizard said, ah, well, I tried to find this elixir.
sentences.zh: 方士说，啊，那个，我确实试着去寻找灵药了。

sentences.en: But the closer we got to the island, the more sea monsters rose up and defeated us.
sentences.zh: 但我们越靠近那个岛，海怪就越多，它们打败了我们。

sentences.en: And so if you can only give us more virgins, more provisions and a squadron of archers,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你能再给我们更多的童男童女、更多的补给和一队弓箭手，

sentences.en: well, I'll be able to get it for you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我就能为你取回灵药了。

sentences.en: You might be able to guess what happened.

sentences.en: The emperor gave him what he wanted.

sentences.zh: 于是徐福出发了，再也没有回到中国。

sentences.en: But what's a little interesting twist in this story
sentences.zh: 但这个故事里有一个有趣的转折点，

sentences.zh: 那就是大约在同一时期，日本流传着一个传说，

sentences.en: about a man who came from China with a boatload of provisions and soldiers.
sentences.zh: 关于一个从中国来的人，带着一船的补给和士兵。

sentences.en: I'm not sure if they mentioned the virgins.
sentences.zh: 我不确定他们是否提到了童男童女。

sentences.en: And that became the foundation of Japanese civilization.

sentences.en: This story tells us two things.
sentences.zh: 这个故事告诉我们两件事。

sentences.en: One, humans have been trying to cheat death for thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 第一，人类几千年来一直试图战胜死亡。

sentences.en: And two, the hunger for immortality is inextricably linked to human culture.
sentences.zh: 第二，对永生的渴望与人类文明密不可分。

sentences.en: Almost everything we think of, these technologies of civilization,

sentences.zh: 比如农业、武术、建筑、服饰等等，

sentences.zh: 如果愿意的话，都可以说是延长生命的技术。

sentences.en: And so I think it's unsurprising that at the heart of the promise,
